text: Alternatively, some models for how automated driving systems will impact auto manufacturers hold that carmakers and fleet operators like General Motors (NYSE: GM), Fiat Chrysler, and Waymo will own most of the market's self-driving vehicles, and consumers will simply use them through a ride-hailing service.
